name: Umeme Limited
source: Umeme Limited audited financial statements FY2025 (Ernst & Young Uganda, approved 27 March 2026). Converted UGX -> KES.
source_note: Ushs millions. Audited statement of cash flows for the year ended 31 December 2025 with the 31 December 2024 comparative. Capital expenditure is the printed investment in the distribution network. Operating plus investing plus financing reproduces the printed net increase in cash and cash equivalents in both years.
unit: KES, absolute. Converted from the issuer's Ushs-million figures at 1 UGX = 0.0352 KES (exchange-rates.org, 2024-2025 average); Ushs million x1e6 -> absolute UGX, then -> KES.
